An open data licence is not an open data policy.

facts.fact: LISGIS notice LISGIS/DG/ODL/2026/001, effective 8 June 2026, names CC BY 4.0 as its licence standard and grants a worldwide royalty-free licence to use and redistribute its data, including data on its open data portal, commercially and non-commercially with attribution.
The LISGIS open data licence says it is governed by the laws of Liberia and the National Statistics and Geo-Information Act of 2004, which names the act as in force in 2026.
facts.system: National Statistics and Geo-Information Act of 2004
